'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Craig Teppert LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Craig Teppert]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' No Really It's True Jerry Does Suck!
* '''Username:''' MrGoofball
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
